text: {"lessons":["I felt satisfied selling Stock B and Stock C at gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each position by its role in my overall portfolio.","I should not cling to a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake or treat each stock as a separate account; I should reassess it using current information and portfolio risk.","These few months of price changes do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and trade only when my plan or circumstances warrant it."]}
